digest.component_or_area: completion-verify agent step, tool-call loop breaker
propositions: The completion-verify agent step is dispatched with no tool_step_limit, leaving its only loop-breaker dormant when the primary verifier runs away versus only for recovery sub-calls.
Three of four real runs of the gate loop on repeated tool calls (40-70% waste), but the agent is killed at the step budget with no verdict instead of landing on evidence gathered.

The shipped loop detector max_consecutive_repeat is blind to cycles of length >= 2, scoring pathological runs below healthy ones, making any actuator wired to it fire on good work and miss real cycles.
A windowed distinct-ratio discriminator (window 24, trip <= 0.50) fires on all three pathological runs and never on the healthy one, separating loops from breadth with a ~5x margin.

Setting tool_step_limit to a flat ceiling inverts the budget's design intent (bound failures, not cap capacity) and truncates legitimate breadth work; the actuator must detect runaway repetition and route to the tool-free finalizer instead.
